description: Backend live-log resilience (LLR-1, LLR-2, LLR-3, LLR-4). P0: process-level uncaughtException/unhandledRejection safety net + per-source stream-error containment so a single follow-stream error cannot crash the process (which is what caused the cascading HTTP 502 on describe/metrics via the Vite proxy). P1: bound the Live aggregate path concurrency and add in-flight backpressure, mirroring the History pump instead of starting all sources at once. P2: WebSocket ping/pong heartbeat that reaps dead sockets (running the existing cancelOwnedSession teardown) and an optional follow-stream inactivity deadline. All backend-only, strictly read-only, 127.0.0.1 bind unchanged, no secrets logged. Independent of FEAT-002 (frontend) except that LLR-1 keeping the backend alive is what makes the frontend reconnect in FEAT-002 meaningful.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST. If specs/1.20.0-live-logs-resilience/* or .agents/tasks/investigate-aggregate-log-stream-drop.md are absent in the worktree, read them from /home/idd_galcantara/Documents/ops-flow/. Run `npm install` once at the worktree root if node_modules is absent.

LLR-1: In backend/src/index.ts register process.on('uncaughtException') and process.on('unhandledRejection'). Extract the handler + a sanitizer into a new backend/src/processGuards.ts (reuse safeErrorMessage from kube/podsService.ts) that logs sanitized message+stack via console.error and does NOT exit for in-flight runtime errors. Preserve the existing SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown() and server.on('error') EADDRINUSE non-zero exit; keep startup/bind-fatal paths exiting non-zero. Add backend/src/processGuards.test.ts asserting the sanitizer strips a secret-bearing ApiException-style message (no 'authorization'/'Body: secret') and the handler does not call an injected exit spy for a runtime error.

LLR-2: In backend/src/kube/logsService.ts ensure streamStructuredPodLogs AND streamPodLogs route PassThrough 'error', open-time .catch, and any post-open rejection to callbacks.onError exactly once (guard double-finish). In backend/src/logsSubscription.ts confirm startSource keeps a source error source-scoped and a streamFactory throw is caught. Extend backend/src/logsSubscription.test.ts to prove one source failing (open-time throw AND post-open stream error) does not abort sibling sources and does not reject past the handler. If needed add a minimal optional injectable stream/log-client seam to logsService.ts (NO new libraries) so post-open errors are testable without a cluster; extend backend/src/kube/logsService.test.ts accordingly.

LLR-3 limits: Add MAX_ACTIVE_LIVE_SOURCE_READS=8 to backend/src/resourceLimits.ts (aligned with MAX_ACTIVE_KUBERNETES_READS). Add to backend/src/logsProtocol.ts: MAX_LIVE_STREAMS_PER_CONNECTION = MAX_LOG_SOURCES, MAX_LIVE_INFLIGHT_BYTES_PER_SOURCE = 4*1024*1024, MAX_LIVE_INFLIGHT_BYTES_PER_SESSION = 32*1024*1024.

LLR-3 scheduler: In backend/src/logsSubscription.ts replace `for (const state of states) startSource(state)` with a bounded pump mirroring HistorySourcePump (hold a queue; while activeReads < MAX_ACTIVE_LIVE_SOURCE_READS and active streams < MAX_LIVE_STREAMS_PER_CONNECTION, start the next queued source; decrement activeReads and re-pump on each source's onEnd/onError terminal). Still emit sourceStarted for EVERY source up front. Apply per-source and per-session in-flight decoded-byte backpressure using the new caps while keeping DEFAULT_LOG_LIMITS content caps unchanged. Make the limits injectable via an optional options argument (default to the new constants) so tests can set tiny bounds. Do NOT change the AggregateLogEvent WS schema (no new event/field).

LLR-3 tests: Extend backend/src/logsSubscription.test.ts: (a) with more sources than the bound and a factory counting live (not-yet-ended) handles, assert concurrent active starts never exceed MAX_ACTIVE_LIVE_SOURCE_READS and that starting the next source happens only after an earlier one terminates; (b) sourceStarted emitted exactly once per source; (c) per-connection cap enforced; (d) in-flight backpressure engages when a source floods beyond the per-source cap.

LLR-4 deadline: Add optional inactivityMs to StructuredLogOptions/LogStreamOptions in backend/src/kube/logsService.ts; implement a resettable timer (reset on each data chunk) that on expiry runs the existing stop cleanup (abort?.abort()+stream.destroy()) and emits a per-source onEnd('cancelled')/onError without throwing, clearing the timer on stop/finish. Default undefined = current behavior. Extend backend/src/kube/logsService.test.ts (using the injectable seam) to assert a clean onEnd on expiry with no unhandled throw.

LLR-4 heartbeat: Add heartbeatIntervalMs? option to attachLogsWebSocket in backend/src/logsWebSocket.ts; track isAlive per ws, set alive on 'pong', and each interval terminate() non-responders and ping() the rest. Ensure terminate() runs the socket's cancelOwnedSession() (verify ws.on('close') fires on terminate; add explicit cleanup if any path bypasses it). Clear the interval on wss.close()/server close. Preserve existing ws.on('close'/'error', cancelOwnedSession). Extend backend/src/logsWebSocket.test.ts: a dead socket (never pongs) with a short interval is terminated and its subscription cancelled / per-source stop() observed via the stream factory.

If any transient internal state was considered for the WS protocol, keep it internal and document in specs/1.20.0-live-logs-resilience/design.md that no WS schema change was introduced (contract impact: none).

Run the FEAT-001 verification commands below; set this FEAT status to completed and record in findings any seams/limits added and anything FEAT-002 or the review phase needs. Commit locally on branch feature/live-logs-resilience; never push.
acceptance_criteria: backend/src/index.ts registers uncaughtException and unhandledRejection handlers that log sanitized output and do not exit on a runtime error, while SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown and EADDRINUSE non-zero exit are preserved.
A single source stream error (open-time or post-open) stays source-scoped: sibling sources keep streaming and no rejection escapes to crash the covered path.

startLogSubscription starts sources through a bounded pump: concurrent active starts never exceed MAX_ACTIVE_LIVE_SOURCE_READS, the per-connection cap (<= MAX_LOG_SOURCES) holds, in-flight backpressure applies, and sourceStarted is still emitted once per source.

attachLogsWebSocket terminates a socket that fails heartbeat and that teardown cancels the subscription and stops upstream follow streams; follow streams honor an optional inactivity deadline that ends cleanly without throwing.
No mutating Kubernetes call added; backend still binds only 127.0.0.1; no secrets/tokens/certs/authorization headers logged or returned by new paths; AggregateLogEvent WS schema unchanged.
`npm test --workspace=backend` passes including all new tests; `npm run typecheck` clean.
findings:
All backend LLR-1..LLR-4 implemented; backend suite 116 tests pass (was 104), typecheck/build clean, diff --check clean. No WS schema change (AggregateLogEvent untouched); read-only + 127.0.0.1 bind preserved; sanitization via safeErrorMessage throughout.

SEAMS ADDED (for FEAT-002 / reviewer):
- backend/src/kube/logsService.ts: new injectable LogStreamClient / LogStreamClientFactory seam. LogStreamOptions gained optional logClientFactory (test seam) and inactivityMs (LLR-4 follow deadline; default undefined = unchanged behavior). StructuredLogOptions inherits both. KubeLogRequestOptions interface exported. The real default (defaultLogClientFactory) is a thin adapter over logForContext — behavior unchanged in production.
- backend/src/logsSubscription.ts: startLogSubscription gained a 4th optional arg StartLogSubscriptionOptions { limits?: Partial<LiveSubscriptionLimits> } so tests can set tiny bounds. Exported LiveSubscriptionLimits + DEFAULT_LIVE_SUBSCRIPTION_LIMITS. SourceState now has 'queued' status and inFlightBytes; scheduling is a bounded pump() mirroring HistorySourcePump (activeReads cap + per-connection cap, re-pump on every terminal). sourceStarted still emitted once per admitted source up front. In-flight decoded-byte backpressure: onLine returns false when a synchronous flood would exceed per-source/per-session caps; drained on a microtask so normal interleaved traffic never trips it.
- backend/src/processGuards.ts (new): registerProcessGuards()/handleProcessError()/sanitizeFatal()/sanitizeStack(). Wired in index.ts BEFORE server setup. Handlers log sanitized message+stack and DO NOT exit on runtime errors; SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown() and server.on('error') EADDRINUSE non-zero exit are untouched.
- backend/src/logsWebSocket.ts: attachLogsWebSocket gained optional heartbeatIntervalMs (exported DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS = 30000; 0 disables). WeakSet alive-tracking + 'pong'; each interval terminates non-responders (terminate() fires 'close' -> existing cancelOwnedSession -> subscription.cancel()/per-source stop()) and pings the rest. Interval cleared on wss 'close' and server 'close'. markAlive(ws) is called for BOTH the aggregate and legacy upgrade paths.

LIMITS CHOSEN:
- resourceLimits.ts: MAX_ACTIVE_LIVE_SOURCE_READS = 8 (aligned with MAX_ACTIVE_KUBERNETES_READS).
- logsProtocol.ts: MAX_LIVE_STREAMS_PER_CONNECTION = MAX_LOG_SOURCES (50); MAX_LIVE_INFLIGHT_BYTES_PER_SOURCE = 4*1024*1024; MAX_LIVE_INFLIGHT_BYTES_PER_SESSION = 32*1024*1024 (mirror DEFAULT_HISTORY_LIMITS).
- DEFAULT_LOG_LIMITS content caps left unchanged.

FEAT-002 note: index.ts currently attaches the WS with the default 30s heartbeat (no heartbeatIntervalMs passed); frontend reconnection in FEAT-002 relies on LLR-1 keeping the backend alive so describe/metrics stop cascading to 502. No frontend files were touched. The spec design.md (main repo, untracked) got an implementation note confirming contract impact: none; it is NOT part of this commit.
